battle.name: 竇建德兼併魏刀兒之戰
battle.brief: 大業十三年（617），自號歷山飛、眾逾十萬的河北首領魏刀兒與竇建德由並肩轉為相攻，竇建德在趙、魏、洺水一線擊破其眾，併其兵眾城池，河北遂歸其一家的地盤。卡面科林斯青銅盔雖非戰場之物，其「靠隊形活」的道理，正是這批以方陣自保的起兵眾的寫照。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 交戰的一方是竇建德率領的河北起兵眾。竇建德是清河漳南（漳州）一帶的農家出身，隋末在河北聚眾起事，以高雞泊與樂壽一帶為基地，眾多為鄉里農民與散兵，器械雜用、編制不統一；大業十三年（617）正月在樂壽稱長樂王；其勢力早已越過十萬之眾，靠吞併河北各股起兵隊伍（高士達、張金稱餘眾等）迅速擴張。另一方是魏刀兒的起兵眾，即《隋書》《資治通鑑》所載的魏刁兒，自號「歷山飛」：大業十一年（615）十月與上谷王須拔同起，眾各十餘萬，北連突厥、南寇趙地，其部將甄翟兒又於大業十二年（616）四月率眾十萬寇太原，殺隋將潘長文，聲勢遠在竇建德之上。這支部眾與竇建德同處河北，起初因各有敵人（官軍與旁支群雄）而並肩自保，局勢一緊便互相吞併；兼併的結果，是河北再沒有第二家能與竇建德抗爭的武裝。背景中還有兩股力量要交代：隋朝方面，郡兵在隋末多已崩潰倒戈，大業十二年楊義臣討張金稱、十三年薛世雄討竇建德，都是臨時遠征編隊，主將一敗便告瓦解，隋廷的羈縻授官也已失效；唐初則以關中為根本遣使招撫河北群雄，竇建德與魏刀兒先後被列入招撫與討伐的名單。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the Hebei rebel host led by Dou Jiande and the rebel host of Wei Dao'er, that is the Wei Diao'er of the Sui History and the Comprehensive Mirror, who styled himself Lishan Fei. Dou Jiande came from a farming family in the Zhangnan (Zhangzhou) area of Qinghe; he raised a force in Hebei in the last years of the Sui and made the Gaocibo marsh and the Leshou region his base, his men mostly peasants from the villages and scattered soldiers, with mixed equipment and no uniform organisation. When he proclaimed himself Prince of Changle at Leshou in the first month of the thirteenth year of Daye (AD 617) his strength had long since passed the hundred thousand mark, and he had grown quickly by absorbing the other Hebei insurgent bands, those of Gao Shida and the remnants of Zhang Jincheng among them. Wei Dao'er's host was much the greater. In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Daye (AD 615) he rose together with Wang Xuba of Shanggu, each claiming more than a hundred thousand men, linking north to the Turks and raiding south into Zhao territory; his commander Zhen Di'er led a hundred thousand men against Taiyuan in the fourth month of the following year (AD 616) and killed the Sui general Pan Changwen. The two hosts stood in the same Hebei and at first sheltered each other, each having enemies of his own in the government troops and the neighbouring strongmen, but as the situation tightened they began to swallow each other; the result of the absorption was that Hebei had no second armed force left able to contend with Dou Jiande. Two further forces have to be taken into account. On the Sui side the commandery levies had largely collapsed or defected by the end of the dynasty, and the expeditions of Yang Yichen against Zhang Jincheng in the twelfth year of Daye and of Xue Shixiong against Dou Jiande in the thirteenth were temporary task forces that dissolved as soon as their commander was beaten; the Sui court's method of binding the insurgents by title had already failed. In the new Tang, envoys were sent out from the base in Guanzhong to pacify the Hebei strongmen, and both Dou Jiande and Wei Dao'er were entered on the lists of those to be won over or destroyed.
people: 核心人物是竇建德。他的生年史無定說，《舊唐書》記其被擒時年六十二；他大業七年（611）冬以鄉里數百人起事，至大業十二年（616）已是勝兵十餘萬、自稱將軍，一度為北方最大的義軍首領，據樂壽、冀州等河北重鎮。史傳他起兵後以信義相結，重用河北舊吏與鄉兵渠帥，作戰先設陣而後進；其參謀凌敬主張先取河北以為根本、再圖天下，這個取捨在他晚年決定了河北與關中的勝負。兼併魏刀兒時，他並未選擇與對手硬拼到底，而是先斷其外援、孤立其眾，再以主力一次擊破，把對方的兵眾與城池一併收編，使自己的規模在數月之間膨脹數倍，這是河北群雄中最見效率的一次擴張。魏刀兒即自號歷山飛的河北大首領，早年靠聚眾與據守鄉里打開局面，勢力曾橫跨趙、魏與太原三面，卻未能整合旗下各部，也沒有穩固的根據地；兼併之後其人下落諸史說法不一，一說戰歿於陣，一說為部下所殺，一說脫身後不知所在。與他們同期在河北舉事的還有王須拔、張金稱、高士達：魏刀兒與王須拔同年起事、眾各十餘萬；張金稱於大業十二年為楊義臣所討平；高士達本為另一支起義軍首領，率眾歸附竇建德後仍獨當一面，後為隋將張須陀所破。隋方的對手是薛世雄與張須陀；唐方的樞紐是李淵、李世民父子，而李世民的介入最終改寫了河北的歸屬。
peopleEn: The central figure is Dou Jiande. The date of his birth is not settled, and the Old Book of Tang records that he was sixty-two years old when he was captured; in the winter of the seventh year of Daye (AD 611) he rose with a few hundred men from his own village, and by the twelfth year of Daye (AD 616) was already credited with more than a hundred thousand men under arms and styling himself general, at moments the greatest of the northern rebel chiefs, holding the Hebei strongholds of Leshou and Jizhou. The histories say that after raising his troops he bound men to him by trust and good faith, employed the old officials of Hebei together with the village leaders of the local levies, and in battle always formed up before he advanced. His adviser Ling Jing urged him to take Hebei as his foundation first and then seek the empire, and that choice of ordering decided the fate of Hebei against Guanzhong in his last years. When he took over Wei Dao'er he did not choose to grind the opponent down in a straight fight; he cut off the enemy's external support and isolated his followers, then broke him in one decisive stroke with his main force, absorbing the enemy soldiers and the enemy cities at a single time, so that his own strength swelled severalfold within a few months — the most efficient single expansion among the Hebei strongmen. Wei Dao'er, the Hebei chief who styled himself Lishan Fei, had opened his position in earlier years by gathering followers and holding the countryside, and his power had stretched across three fronts, Zhao, Wei and Taiyuan, yet he never managed to weld his various bands together and had no firm base; after the absorption his own fate is given in conflicting accounts: some say he died in the fight, some that his own men killed him, others that he escaped and was never heard from again. Others who rose in Hebei at the same time were Wang Xuba, Zhang Jincheng and Gao Shida: Wei Dao'er and Wang Xuba rose together, each with more than a hundred thousand men; Zhang Jincheng was put down by Yang Yichen in the twelfth year of Daye; Gao Shida had been the chief of a separate insurgent band and kept a command of his own after joining Dou Jiande, and was later broken by the Sui general Zhang Xutuo. The Sui opponents were Xue Shixiong and Zhang Xutuo; on the Tang side the pivot was Li Yuan and Li Shimin, and Li Shimin's intervention in the end decided to whom Hebei would belong.
kits: 卡面這具科林斯青銅盔，公元前七世紀中葉定型，是希臘重裝步兵的頭部防具：整盔覆面，只留一道縱向鼻脊與兩側眼孔，頸部靠一圈寬闊護頸與肩甲相接；代價是視野極窄、散熱難行，戴者幾乎放棄了用眼睛找目標的可能，只能靠同伴的旗幟、號角與身側的人牆行動——這正是「看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活」的來處。公元六百一十七年的河北戰場上當然沒有這件希臘器物，隋軍的對應裝備是兜鍪配護項與面甲的組合：披膊掩住上臂與頸側，銅葉或鐵葉面甲只露口鼻一線，明光鎧的護胸在日光下反光，藉以在亂陣中維持辨識；步卒以長矛列陣，騎兵用馬槊與直刀，弓弩交射在兩翼展開。竇建德這支部眾的裝備則明顯簡陋：成員多為農民與鄉兵，皮甲、布甲居多，頭部防護以舊氈布纏為主，能湊齊制式兜鍪者有限，因此更依賴長矛密集的方陣與衝撞，而不是個人甲冑的防護力。魏刀兒一軍的眾雖號稱十餘萬，人數多而器械雜，披甲率更低，其戰力大半來自人數與兇悍而非裝備，正需要竇建德那樣的長矛方陣來把這批人變成可以作戰的軍隊。也正因如此，把科林斯青銅盔放上這張卡，講的正是同一個道理：頭盔保護得越好，隊形就越成為唯一的依靠。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card was fixed in form in the middle of the seventh century BC and was the head protection of the Greek heavy infantry: the whole helm covers the face, leaving only a vertical nasal ridge and an opening at each eye, and the neck is closed by a broad flange that meets the shoulder piece. The price is an extremely narrow field of view and poor ventilation; the man wearing it practically gave up finding his target with his eyes and could only act on the standards, the horns and the wall of men at his side. That is where the card's line comes from: the visible cost of the helmet is that the man who wears it can only live by the formation. There was of course no such Greek piece on the field in Hebei in AD 617. The Sui equivalent was the combination of a helmet with a neck guard and a face mask: shoulder flaps covered the upper arm and the side of the neck, bronze or iron face plates left only the mouth and nose in a slit, and the gleaming front plates of the bright armour reflected the sunlight so that a man could still be picked out in a mêlée. Infantry fought in spear ranks, cavalry carried cavalry lances and straight sabres, and bow and crossbow fire was opened up on the flanks. The equipment of Dou Jiande's host was markedly poorer: most of his men were peasants and village levies in leather or cloth armour, their heads protected mostly by old felt and cloth wrappings, and few could be issued regulation helmets. They therefore leaned far more on the density of the spear ranks and on the charge than on the protection of individual armour. Wei Dao'er's host, though it claimed more than a hundred thousand men, was large in numbers and poor in equipment, with a still lower proportion of armoured men, and its fighting power came mostly from its numbers and its ferocity rather than from its gear — which is exactly why it needed a spear formation of Dou Jiande's kind to turn that crowd into an army that could fight. That is why a Corinthian helmet belongs on this card: the better the helmet protects you, the more the formation becomes your only support.
tactics: 這場兼併的戰術細節，諸史留下的文字極少，只能從隋末唐初河北作戰的通例與竇建德本人的用兵習慣推想其大概。竇建德起兵後賴以成名的做法有三：一是合縱連橫，先與同在河北的起兵者分兵合勢，把散兵游勇聚成可以與官軍對抗的集團；二是避實擊虛，避開郡兵與城防完整的縣城，專在鄉里、山寨之間轉戰；三是步兵結陣、騎兵繞擊，每逢大戰先以步卒列陣牽制對手，再遣騎兵迂迴其側後與糧道。兼併魏刀兒時，他大致沿用同一套路：先以遊騎封住對方北向太原與西向代郡的通道，切斷其與高開道等河北勢力、以及與北方突厥的聯繫，使魏刀兒只剩孤軍；然後集中兵力攻其外圍據點與部眾聚落，逼其離開熟悉的鄉里地盤；待對方陣腳一亂即乘勢併入其眾，隨即以受降者補自己的兵源與糧秣，加厚方陣。兩軍接觸多在平原會戰與村落攻奪之間轉換，河北平原適合車馬縱橫而少有山險可恃，決定勝負的往往是糧道與士氣而非城牆。卡面這具科林斯青銅盔在此點出關鍵：全覆的頭盔把人封在自己的世界裡，隊形與傳令就是眼睛的替代品；竇建德的眾多兵同樣如此，方陣越密，個人視野越小，勝敗越取決於號令能否貫穿全隊。
tacticsEn: Almost nothing is recorded about the tactical detail of this takeover, so it can only be reconstructed in outline from the general practice of campaigning in Hebei at the end of the Sui and from Dou Jiande's own habits. Three things made his name after he raised his troops. First, he worked through alliances: he joined forces with the other insurgents in Hebei, gathering scattered fighters into a group that could stand against the government troops. Second, he avoided strongpoints: he left alone the commandery garrisons and the counties with intact walls, and fought instead among the villages and the hill stockades. Third, he paired infantry formations with cavalry envelopment: in every major battle the foot closed ranks to hold the enemy, and then cavalry was sent round the flank and at the enemy's supply line. In taking over Wei Dao'er he followed much the same pattern. He first used light horse to seal the roads north towards Taiyuan and west towards Dai Commandery, cutting Wei off from the other Hebei powers such as Gao Kaidao and from the Turks to the north, and leaving him an isolated army; then he concentrated his strength against the outer posts and the clusters of settlements where Wei's followers lived, driving him off the ground he knew; and as soon as that line began to break he moved in and took the men over, using the surrendered to fill his own ranks and provisions and to thicken his formations. Contact between the two sides passed back and forth between pitched battles on the plain and the assault on villages; the Hebei plain allowed cavalry and wagons to range widely while offering little in the way of broken ground, so what decided such a fight was usually the supply line and the state of the soldiers' morale rather than any wall. The Corinthian helmet on the card makes the point exactly: a fully enclosing helmet shuts a man inside his own small world, and the formation and the signals take the place of his eyes. Dou Jiande's multitude of men were the same in this respect — the denser the ranks, the smaller each man's view, and the more the outcome depended on whether the orders could be carried through the whole line.
data: 可核對的數字不多，先列確有根據的部分。竇建德的生年史無定說，《舊唐書》記其武德四年（621）被擒時年六十二，故此役時他約六十上下。公元六百一十七年對應隋煬帝大業十三年，唐要到次年才在長安建國；大業十三年正月，竇建德在樂壽稱長樂王；《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三記此前大業十二年竇建德已「勝兵十餘萬，自稱將軍」，大業九年則有竇建德與高士達合兵十餘萬、與張須陀戰於河間的記載。魏刀兒一軍的實力有明文可據：大業十一年（615）十月，他與上谷王須拔同起，眾各十餘萬，北連突厥、南寇趙；其部將甄翟兒又於大業十二年（616）四月率眾十萬寇太原，殺隋將潘長文。竇建德一軍則由大業七年（611）冬起兵時的鄉里數百人，十年間增至數萬，並靠兼併他人部眾膨脹。戰役確切的交戰日期與月份，諸史未詳記，本卡暫繫於大業十三年秋季。能確定的因果鏈是清楚的：併掉魏刀兒這一支出逾十萬眾的大部之後，河北便只剩竇建德一家勢力；兩年後唐軍南下，虎牢關一役夏軍十餘萬眾覆滅，竇建德於牛口渚被擒，河北州縣望風歸順。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, so let us set down the ones that have a basis. Dou Jiande's birth date is not settled, but the Old Book of Tang records that he was sixty-two years old when he was captured in the fourth year of Wude (AD 621), so he was about sixty at the time of this takeover. AD 617 corresponds to the thirteenth year of Daye of Sui Emperor Yang, and the Tang would not be founded at Chang'an until the following year; in the first month of that thirteenth year Dou Jiande proclaimed himself Prince of Changle at Leshou, his following by then already above ten thousand. The strength of Wei Dao'er's host is expressly on record: in the tenth month of the eleventh year of Daye (AD 615) he rose together with Wang Xuba of Shanggu, each with more than a hundred thousand men, linking north to the Turks and raiding south into Zhao; his commander Zhen Di'er then led a hundred thousand men against Taiyuan in the fourth month of the twelfth year (AD 616) and killed the Sui general Pan Changwen. Dou Jiande's own force, by contrast, began in the winter of the seventh year of Daye (AD 611) with a few hundred men from his own village; by the twelfth year of Daye the Comprehensive Mirror already credits him with more than a hundred thousand men under arms and the title of general, and there is a record of Dou and Gao Shida joining ten thousand-strong forces to fight Zhang Xutuo at Hejian in the ninth year of Daye. The exact day and month of the engagement are not recorded, and this card assigns it to the autumn of the thirteenth year of Daye. What can be traced with certainty is the chain of cause and effect: once Wei Dao'er's host of more than a hundred thousand men had been swallowed, only Dou Jiande's power was left in Hebei; two years later the Tang army came south, the Xia host of more than a hundred thousand was destroyed at the battle of Hulao Pass, and Dou Jiande was captured at the Niukou shoal, after which the prefectures and counties of Hebei came over to the Tang.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是河北實際控制權之爭：隋末郡縣體系崩解，河北土地肥沃、人丁稠密，饑荒、徭役與逃亡潮把大批農民推上道路，據城、掠糧、聚眾成了活下去的辦法；魏刀兒與竇建德都是這樣的起事者，兩軍同處河北一隅，起初因為各有敵人（官軍與旁支群雄）而互相容身，甚至同進同退，一旦一方坐大，另一方的生路便被堵死。第二層是竇建德自身的雄心：他並不滿足於做一名地方武裝的首領，而要吃掉河北，把散在各家的兵眾與城池收成自己的基業；對魏刀兒而言則是生存之爭——不是他想吞竇建德，而是他不吞竇建德，就會被竇建德吞掉，河北這塊地方容不下兩個這樣的人物，而當時魏刀兒眾逾十萬、勢力還伸到太原去，反倒是竇建德的處境更危險。第三層是隋廷羈縻的失效：隋朝先後給起兵者授官封爵，希望以名分換服從，等到名分失去約束力，雙方便只剩兵戎相見；唐的出現則給了河北另一種選項——接受招撫而歸唐，或者被消滅。竇建德兼併魏刀兒，正是在這個轉折點上、在他要成為河北唯一主人之前，先把身邊最大的一個競爭者清掉。
causeEn: There are three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost is the struggle for actual control of Hebei: the commandery and county system of the Sui had come apart, Hebei had fertile land and a dense population, and famine, corvée labour and a tide of flight pushed large numbers of peasants onto the roads, where seizing a town, taking grain and raising a band had become a way to stay alive. Wei Dao'er and Dou Jiande were both risers of this kind; their two hosts stood in the same corner of Hebei and at first sheltered each other, even marching together, because each had enemies of his own — the government troops and the neighbouring strongmen — but as soon as one of them grew large the other found his way blocked. The second layer is Dou Jiande's own ambition: he was not content to remain the chief of a local armed band; he wanted to swallow Hebei and gather the scattered troops and cities into a base of his own. For Wei Dao'er it was a struggle for survival — not that he wished to devour Dou Jiande, but that unless he devoured Dou Jiande, he would be devoured in turn; Hebei had room for only one such figure, and with Wei's host numbering more than a hundred thousand and stretching as far as Taiyuan, it was Dou's own position that was the more dangerous. The third layer is the failure of the Sui court's method of control: the Sui first granted offices and titles to the insurgents in the hope of buying their submission with rank, and once rank had lost its force there was nothing left for the two sides but arms. The arrival of the Tang gave Hebei a further choice — accept the pacification and come over to the Tang, or be destroyed. Dou Jiande's absorption of Wei Dao'er came precisely at that turning point, before he became sole master of Hebei, when he first cleared away the largest competitor at his side.
impact: 對河北，這場兼併是一道分水嶺：兼併之前，河北起兵群大小首領並立，官軍尚能靠各打各的、各自平叛的辦法拖住局面；兼併之後，河北只剩竇建德一家，他有了足夠的兵眾與城池去與唐爭天下，有了足夠的錢糧去養兵、置官、建制，也有了足夠的勝利去吸引河北的士人與地方豪族歸心。兼併魏刀兒這一支出逾十萬眾的隊伍，等於讓竇建德一步跨過了「地方首領」與「一方割據者」之間的門檻，第二年他便遣使奉表、受封夏王，國號夏，改元明月，並置州郡官屬、追尊祖考，郊天改元——這一切都建立在河北整合完成的基礎上。對唐，這場兼併把北方的邊界問題變簡單了：李世民不必再逐個討伐河北群雄，只需在洺水、虎牢關一線摧毀夏國骨幹，河北諸州便望風而降，唐朝於是把河北納入版圖，不必急著在北方用兵。對後世，這也說明隋末唐初的統一不是靠一次會戰完成，而是靠不斷兼併地方武裝、逐步收縮敵方空間的模式：先消化近處、壯大自己，最後才有條件與最強者正面決戰。
impactEn: For Hebei this takeover was a watershed. Before it, the Hebei insurgents were a field of big and small chiefs standing side by side, and the government troops could still hold things up by letting each rebel be defeated on his own; after it, only Dou Jiande's host was left in Hebei. He now had enough men and cities to contend with the Tang for the realm, enough money and grain to feed an army, appoint officials and build institutions, and enough victories to draw Hebei's scholars and local great families to his side. Absorbing Wei Dao'er's host of more than a hundred thousand men carried Dou Jiande in a single step across the threshold between a local chief and a ruler of a separatist state: the following year he sent an envoy with a memorial, was invested as Prince of Xia, took the name Xia, changed the era to Mingyue, set up the officials of commanderies and prefectures, honoured his ancestors as emperors and performed the suburban sacrifice — all of it resting on the completion of Hebei's unification. For the Tang the takeover simplified the northern problem: Li Shimin no longer had to defeat the Hebei strongmen one by one; a single stroke on the Ming River and Hulao Pass line shattered the backbone of Xia, the prefectures of Hebei came over, and the Tang took Hebei into its territory without having to fight a long northern war. For posterity it also shows that the unification of the late Sui and early Tang was not achieved in one set-piece battle but by a model of constantly absorbing local armed groups and steadily contracting the enemy's space: digest what is nearest first, grow strong, and only then be in a condition to meet the strongest opponent in open battle.
result: 結果是竇建德完勝。魏刀兒一軍在趙、魏一線被擊潰，部眾被拆散、分編入竇建德的序列，一部分隨夏軍作戰，一部分解散返鄉；魏刀兒本人的下落諸史說法不一，無論戰歿、被部下所殺，還是出逃後隱沒，河北再沒有第二支能與竇建德抗衡的武裝。兼併之後，竇建德的兵勢迅速膨脹，佔有河北諸州，並於六百一十八年遣使奉表稱臣、受封夏王，國號夏，進而稱帝改元明月，建立起一套以河北為根基的割據政權。公元六百二十一年，武德四年正月秦王李世民出井陘、徑趨河北，在洺水、虎牢關一線兩度擊破夏軍；四月竇建德率十餘萬眾南下救援被王世充圍困的洛陽，唐軍以精騎約三千五百掩護步兵衝陣，竇軍大潰，竇建德為部下所執，於牛口渚被追獲，押送長安，授將軍，留京閑居數年，至貞觀十八年（644）因與舊部謀反被處死；河北諸州縣隨即望風歸順。回頭看，公元六百一十七年河北南部那場不見於詳戰記錄的兼併，正是這條結局的第一級台階：先兼併魏刀兒、張金稱等部眾而獨霸河北，再被唐軍在一次正面會戰中連根拔起，兩件事相距不足五年，中間只隔著虎牢關一役。
resultEn: The result was an outright victory for Dou Jiande. Wei Dao'er's host was broken on the Zhao and Wei line, its men broken up and enrolled into Dou's ranks, some serving with the Xia army and some dispersed homeward. Wei's own fate is given differently in the histories; whether he fell in the fight, was killed by his own men, or escaped and vanished, Hebei never again had a second armed force able to stand against Dou Jiande. After the absorption Dou's strength swelled rapidly, he held the prefectures of Hebei, and in AD 618 he sent an envoy with a memorial declaring himself a subject and was invested as Prince of Xia, taking the name Xia, and later proclaiming himself emperor and changing the era to Mingyue, so that a separatist regime rooted in Hebei was built up. In AD 621, in the first month of the fourth year of Wude, the Prince of Qin, Li Shimin, marched out through Jingxing into Hebei and broke the Xia army twice on the Ming River and Hulao Pass line; in the fourth month Dou Jiande led more than a hundred thousand men south to relieve Luoyang, which Wang Shichong was besieging, and the Tang army covered its advance with some three thousand five hundred cavalry while its infantry charged, and the Xia host collapsed; Dou Jiande was taken by his own men, run down and caught at the Niukou shoal, taken to Chang'an, granted the rank of general, kept at the capital for several years, and executed in the eighteenth year of Zhenguan (AD 644) for plotting with his old subordinates; the prefectures and counties of Hebei then came over to the Tang. Looking back, the takeover on the southern Hebei plain in AD 617, which no detailed battle record preserves, was the first step of that ending: first the absorption of Wei Dao'er and Zhang Jincheng and the mastery of Hebei alone, then the uprooting of the whole thing by a Tang army in one set-piece battle — two things less than five years apart, with the battle of Hulao Pass between them.
